notes: Pilot 1 (S2S/WebRTC): LiveKit Cloud worker + Gemini Live; a synthetic room participant plays the frozen corpus. Budget-lean cohort: >=120 valid turns per cohort, multiple utterances per call to cut setup overhead; expected spend near $0 on LiveKit/Gemini free tiers (cap is retry headroom). p50/p95 publishable; p99 thin and labeled directional until the cohort is topped up. Clone with cohort=cold for the cold cohort — cohorts are never mixed. Region, machine class, and model versions are pinned at run time and land in the config hash. Free-tier rate limits mean runs spread over days, not hours. Adapter contract: evals/measure/adapters/README.md.
